verdict.rationale: Docs mention Linux-native tooling (Docker Engine, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, nvidia-smi) implying Linux support, and community threads describe hands-on Linux-based GPU virtualization (VFIO passthrough, Fabric Manager, Cloud Hypervisor) as independent real-world testing, but there is no explicit reference to dedicated Linux driver release notes or version history, nor formal independent Linux benchmarking of the B200 itself. missing for 10: documented Linux driver release notes/changelog, explicit independent Linux performance/compatibility testing reports.
